architecture: locked synthetic plain FlowBlock graphs built through production BlockGraph APIs (add_block/add_edge with UNIQUE per-block indices/addresses — Rugra keys block identity on get_index(), Ghidra uses parent pointers; structure_loops entry state per cc:2177-2180); no AddrSpace, no Funcdata, no PcodeOps — CollapseStructure is driven directly
compiler_spec: not applicable: no Funcdata, no prototype model, no symbols (pure BlockGraph fixture)

analysis_options.entrypoint: CollapseStructure::collapseAll on structureLoops-labeled synthetic graphs (Rugra: CollapseStructure::collapse_all, the faithful 5-step path)
analysis_options.prestate: per-case fresh BlockGraph, edges added in a fixed creation order; spanning tree + irreducible + loop labels established by structure_loops exactly as the oracle run() does
analysis_options.observation: per case: final top-level component list (order + type + interior-goto + out-edge labels/targets), the full structure tree (component types in factory child order, gototarget names, gotoout/flip flags), and every original block's surviving out-edge labels + flip + listed flags

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, and cases
cases: latch_pair_goto_dowhile: the main @321a topology (b0->b1; b1->{b2,b3}; b2->{b3,b1}) — selectGoto marks b1->b3, ruleBlockGoto wraps newBlockIfGoto, cat merges ifgoto+latch, forceOutputNum(2) resurrects the internalized latch back-edge as the composite SELF lb edge, ruleBlockDoWhile absorbs; final tree list>dowhile>list>properif(gototarget=b3)+b2
chain_tail_backedge_dowhile: no goto — straight chain b0->b1->b2 with tail b2->{b3,b1}: cat + forceOutputNum + forceFalseEdge + dowhile; isolates the pure newBlockList force semantic

tail_out0_internal_flip: tail out(0) points back INTO the chain (out0 internalized) — forceFalseEdge's out0->getParent()==this arm swaps the self edge to slot 0 and ruleBlockDoWhile negates (cc:1566-1569): observable flip=1 on the folded condition leaf

observation_schema.format: per case: 'case <name>', 'list=...', one 'cN type=... gotoout=... out=[slot:flags->target]' line plus an indented 'tree cN:' block per top-level component, one 'bN out=[slot:flags] flip=. listed=.' line per original block, then 'end'
observation_schema.normalization: block identity prints as creation-order names (bN) / top-level list positions (cN), never pointers or indices; edge labels print as semantic flag letters (g l d i t f c b x, '-'); BlockGoto children are not dumped on either side (Rugra wraps in place, documented); IfGoto composites dump only the condition child (newBlockIfGoto nodes={cond}, block.cc:1809 — Rugra's non-Option if_body placeholder is not a child)

coverage.newblocklist_force_output_num: MATCH: cat chains whose tail out-edges went internal (chain_tail_backedge_dowhile, latch_pair_goto_dowhile) end with a composite SELF lb edge (forceOutputNum, block.cc:880-889 via blockaction-side try_rule_cat force_output_num) exactly as the oracle — pre-fix Rugra produced a 1-out composite and dowhile never fired
coverage.newblocklist_force_false_edge: MATCH: external out0 keeps slot 0 (cases 1/2); internalized out0 (tail_out0_internal_flip) triggers the parent==this arm — self edge swapped to slot 0 and ruleBlockDoWhile negates (flip=1 both sides)
coverage.dowhile_absorption_chain: MATCH: the full main @321a chain (ruleBlockGoto->newBlockIfGoto detach goto edge; ruleBlockCat merge ifgoto+latch with force; ruleBlockDoWhile absorb the self latch) — final tree list>dowhile>list>properif(gototarget)+latch identical on both sides
coverage.goto_edge_detach: MATCH: after newBlockIfGoto the goto target block loses the in-edge (b3 in-degree) and the composite keeps the single structured out-edge (b1->b2 tree edge preserved as out[0])
coverage.edge_label_survival: MATCH: per-vertex surviving out-edge labels (tree/back/loop letters) identical, including the composite self edge's lb label on the collapsed representation
